scope: Published candidate cloud only; intensity>=0 encodes raw surface gain+array_index/10000, -1 visited. Does not expose frontier gain, preselected virtual coverage or exploring-cell membership. Counts do not reconstruct the actual selection queue. Latest collision/route timestamps may precede cloud. Fields prefixed gate use the latest bag map before viewpoint-phase end estimated from phase timing logs; computed terrain history/footprint mirror the map-frame configuration-score protocol with threshold0.5/radius0.6m. They are not an exact capture of the internal map pointer or all graph state.
